summary.text: After go-live, every network routes growth through a named relationship owner: Visa's Client Success manager and account team, Mastercard's account managers, Amex relationship managers and Discover account executives.
Self-service ordering exists only in patches. Mastercard Connect has a Store with Request, checkout and Track Orders, and Amex has Service Enrollment inside Knowledge Base.
Visa sends community issuers to a product enrolment portal on Visa Online. Discover enrols fraud products by PDF application or web form, and PULSE enrols new clients through an account executive.
Incentives are the main commercial lever, worth 15.75 billion dollars at Visa and 20.5 billion at Mastercard in their 2025 years.
Both networks estimate what a partner has earned from volume, card issuance and card conversion forecasts, and Visa uses client-reported data as one input.
Tracking happens inside the network. Job postings describe incentive tracking files, Power BI dashboards, an Oracle billing system and regional quarterly incentive reviews.
The study found no public sign of a partner-facing incentive tracker at any network. This is a gap in the public record, and it may exist behind login.
Mastercard contracts carry clawbacks and customer commitments, and DOJ alleges Visa can claw back paid incentives as early termination fees.
Exit is written into the Mastercard and Visa rulebooks, and it is heavy. Maestro and Cirrus principals give a year's notice, cards must be cancelled and fees are not refunded.
A Visa member cannot finish leaving until every BIN is released, and a BIN must sit inactive for 120 days first.
Conversions are paid for and tooled towards the incumbent. Visa Account Updater carries Mastercard, Amex and Discover portfolios into Visa, and outside Latin America it carries none out.
Consulting is a paid line at Visa and Mastercard, and UK acquirers say they buy scheme services just to understand their own fees.
The Discover family's strongest growth asset is the PULSE Debit Dashboard, open to every PULSE issuer, with interchange by category and a peer comparison.
Discover's owner ran the largest recent conversion, about 25 million debit cards, and merchants and processors bore visible costs from it.
Regulators are opening renewal and exit. Canada lets merchants cancel penalty-free within 70 days of a fee rise, and the UK and Australia now require fee transparency.
The public record is thin on business review content, incentive statements and exit terms at Amex and Discover. Those sit in gated manuals and contracts.

by_partner.partner_type: Large issuers (large banks and co-brand issuers)

how_it_works.text: Visa signs long-term incentive contracts with banks and estimates each client's earnings from volume, card issuance and card conversion forecasts.
A Client Incentive Operations team loads each contract into Oracle Revenue Management and Billing, schedules payments and checks with clients whether obligations were met.
A Client Success manager owns a Client Success Plan and post-sale service, beside a separate account team.
Growth offers include Visa Consulting and Analytics, run as Diagnose, Align, Roadmap and Implement, and the self-service Visa Analytics Platform with peer benchmarks.
Visa says some clients can leave on relatively short notice without significant fees. DOJ alleges a debit issuer missing growth targets could owe earned benefits back plus a fixed fee.
To leave, a member releases every BIN after 120 inactive days and stays liable for earlier exceptions and fees.
BINs cannot be sold, so a portfolio sale is notified to Visa, and a buyer that is not a member files within 10 days or stops.

tools_and_screens.name: Visa Access Client Portfolio Management Self-Service Tools
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Program Request Management, the electronic Client Information Questionnaire and the Visa Client Support Application, for Visa profile and programme changes.

tools_and_screens.name: Client Directory in Visa Access
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Member contacts and service providers, which members must update within 10 business days of a change.

tools_and_screens.name: Visa Analytics Platform
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Self-service dashboards on portfolio, fraud, approvals and disputes against a competitive peer set.

tools_and_screens.name: Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (internal)
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Visa's own system for incentive contract set-up and payments. Partners do not see it.

friction.text: DOJ alleges nearly 1,000 Visa issuing contracts carry volume incentives that deter adding debit networks.
DOJ alleges issuers rarely change network, partly because reissuing cards is costly.
An analyst expects Visa would reverse discounts across a defecting bank's whole portfolio. This is opinion with no disclosed term behind it.

how_it_works.text: Mastercard pays rebates and incentives when customers meet volume thresholds, and estimates performance from card issuance and card conversion volumes.
Deal managers monitor contracts, calculate incentive payments, join regional quarterly incentive reviews and discuss deal performance with customers.
Drafted contracts are checked against the approved business case, including term, clawbacks and customer commitments.
Mastercard says its data services help it win new and renewed deals, and account teams build revenue and expense benchmarks for customers.
In January 2026 Mastercard renewed Capital One's credit partnership and kept a large portion of newly acquired credit accounts.
Mastercard says customers can reassess commitments within their contract terms, and its Advisors consulting line sells strategy and implementation help.
Mastercard may also end a licence after 26 weeks without activity or when a customer falls short of its approved business plan.
To leave, a Principal gives 30 days' notice for a Mastercard licence and a year for Maestro or Cirrus, then cancels cards and notifies cardholders.
A portfolio sale needs 30 days' written notice to Mastercard, and a terminated customer gets no refund of fees.

tools_and_screens.name: Mastercard Connect Store
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Applications and reports a company can request, each with a Request button, a checkout form scoping data by ICA, BIN or account range, and Track Orders.

tools_and_screens.name: Pricing and Billing Resource Center
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: The Pricing Guide and a Transaction Detail tool, requested through the Connect Store.

tools_and_screens.name: Mastercard Business Intelligence (Portfolio Advisor)
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Self-service approval recommendations from competitive benchmarks and past performance.

tools_and_screens.name: Variance Manager
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Requests to depart from a Mastercard standard, with a stated reason.

friction.text: Mastercard warns it may have to raise incentives and discounts to meet customer demand for better pricing.
From April 2026 Mastercard added services to a US bundle fee and raised its rate, per a merchant advisory.

how_it_works.text: Each GNS issuer's rate is negotiated individually and not published.
Amex offers licensed issuers data and analytics with benchmarking and best practice, plus predictive models for marketing.
New value-added capabilities are certified through the issuer's relationship manager, who supplies scripts and test cases.
Cobrand deals run for a fixed period, and Amex seeks renewal before the term ends.
Some cobrand partners may buy the card loans, or name a buyer, when the deal ends. Amex may not renew its Amazon and Lowe's small business portfolios.
Amex cites its 2016 loss of Costco in the US as an example of non-renewal.
The Amazon business cards moved to U.S. Bank on Mastercard, with Amex cardholders migrating on 14 August 2026.
Amex itself exited GNS licensing in the EU and Australia and terminated existing EU licences after regulation.

tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: One place to read about each network service and enrol directly.

tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Training assigned by Knowledge Base profile, including a card acquisition campaign webinar.

friction.text: The public webinar list stops at June 2022, so current growth training is not visible.
Exit terms sit in the gated Business and Operational Policies manual.

how_it_works.text: Discover enters fixed-term pricing or incentive deals with some participants and competes on incentives and rebates, publishing no amounts.
Its deferred incentive balance was 28 million dollars at end-2024, against billions at Visa and Mastercard.
The owner says rival networks give issuers large signing bonuses and hold long, sometimes exclusive, bank deals.
Capital One moved about 25 million debit cards onto the network and is testing new and converted credit accounts.
Venture X and several co-brands stay on Visa, and Capital One names Mexico, the Caribbean, Canada and the UK as acceptance priorities.
Diners Club International sells an exclusive issuer franchise per market, applied for by email.

tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Named owner of contracts, technical upgrades and configuration changes.

The network's owner competes with partner issuers and bought Brex, a corporate card rival to fintech partners.

best_pattern.text: Mastercard publishes exit in its public rulebook: a notice table by licence type, portfolio sale notice, card cancellation and a duty to help merchants move.

discover_today.text: Discover publishes no issuer incentive terms or exit steps, and its owner's own conversion is the reference case. Relationships run through account executives.

how_it_works.text: Participating community issuers join Visa's Community Growth Acceleration Program and enrol in products through a portal on Visa Online.
The Merchant Offers Program, over 30 Visa-negotiated offers, is also reached through Visa Online.
ICBA Payments, a Visa principal, renewed its community bank partnership with Visa in July 2025.
Credit unions switching to Visa reissue every card, as Liberty Bay did after a new debit processor made the brand change possible.
Clearwater used Visa Account Updater to refresh stored cards at participating merchants, and Cobalt disabled old cards on a set date.
Exempt issuers received 1.32 billion dollars of network payments and incentives in 2023, more per transaction than covered issuers.

tools_and_screens.name: Visa Online product enrolment portal
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: The enrolment route for Community Growth Acceleration Program products and the Merchant Offers Program.

tools_and_screens.name: Visa Account Updater

Credit unions tell members to update recurring payments themselves, since the updater covers participating merchants only.

how_it_works.text: Navigant Credit Union moved its debit cards from Visa to Mastercard in 2025, with new numbers and PINs that did not carry over.
Mastercard's Automatic Billing Updater records brand flips and portfolio upgrades as lifecycle events.
A community issuer can request tools such as Portfolio Advisor through Mastercard Business Intelligence and Connect.

how_it_works.text: The study found no public route for a US community bank or credit union to issue on Amex. Rulebooks come only after signing.

friction.text: The public record is thin here.

how_it_works.text: PULSE frames its Partner Support Services as starting after the contract: Debit Dashboard, DebitProtect, Marketing Hub, disputes support and research.
The Debit Dashboard, open to every PULSE issuer, shows revenue, expense and approvals by BIN, interchange by category and a peer comparison.
PULSE participation agreements generally renew automatically with no fixed term, and Discover runs fixed-term incentive deals with some participants.
To win conversions, PULSE invites issuers to re-evaluate their debit programme, promising a dedicated account rep and a one-page invoice.
Three brand-switch case studies are published, each gated behind a download form.
PULSE runs an annual Voice of the Client survey and a Debit Issuer Study.

tools_and_screens.name: PULSE Debit Dashboard
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Overview by BIN or BIN range, activity by PULSE product, interchange by category, Peer Comparison and exportable report templates.

tools_and_screens.name: Marketing Hub
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Custom campaigns, card art and cardholder education for Discover Debit issuers.

friction.text: A PULSE account executive says most issuers do not know the exact interchange they earn or their total costs.
New DebitProtect clients enrol through an account executive, with no self-service route.

how_it_works.text: SHAZAM gives each member institution one vote and a member-elected board.
UnionPay International's Member Council shapes rules and incentive schemes.

best_pattern.text: The PULSE Debit Dashboard gives every issuer its own economics by BIN with a peer comparison, the basis for a business review both sides can see.

discover_today.text: Discover leads here on reporting and simple billing, while enrolment still runs through account executives and conversion evidence is gated.

how_it_works.text: A Visa acquirer takes transactions only from merchants in its own country unless Visa approves otherwise.
Moving a BIN to a new processor obliges the new processor to finish activity on it, unless the old one agrees to.
Visa runs merchant acceptance incentive agreements through the same Client Incentive Operations team as issuer deals.
Visa Acceptance clients change set-up through a MID Configuration Request support case.

tools_and_screens.name: Visa Acceptance Support Center
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: General Support Request and MID Configuration Request cases, behind sign-in.

friction.text: DOJ alleges Visa's routing contracts let it end deals early and claw back incentives, and that over 180 large merchants and acquirers hold de facto exclusive deals.
UK acquirers told the regulator they buy extra scheme services to understand their own fees.

how_it_works.text: To enter a new country an acquirer applies to extend its licence's Area of Use, and Mastercard amends the licence if it approves.
Some cross-border programmes need only a Form 1336 certification emailed at least 14 days ahead.
A leaving acquirer must notify its merchants and help move those that want to keep accepting.
Mastercard sells acquirers Test & Learn and Acquiring Optimizer data products.

how_it_works.text: Amex grows acceptance by signing acquirers market by market, such as three Thai banks in August 2026.
Amex Canada charges acquirers an Existing Merchant Conversion Fee on merchants that previously contracted directly with Amex.
Acquirers are offered closed-loop fraud tools, portfolio analytics and servicing support.

tools_and_screens.name: Knowledge Base Service Enrollment
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Self-service enrolment in network services.

friction.text: Exit terms for GNS acquirers are not public.

how_it_works.text: A Discover Global Network account executive owns the processor's contracts, technical upgrades and configuration changes.
Operations support runs through the EASI Message Center.
One enablement brings the network alliance ranges, and Discover calls Enhanced Decisioning free once data fields are certified.
Moorwand extended its Diners Club issuing licence to UK acquiring in December 2025.
JCB and Discover said in May 2026 they would explore simpler processes for partners of both networks.

tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: The published route to the operations team for acquirers and processors.

friction.text: The study found no public Discover procedure for expanding into a market or leaving the network.

how_it_works.text: Canada's Code makes networks give acquirers 120 days' notice of non-structural fee changes and 210 days for structural ones.

best_pattern.text: Mastercard's Area of Use rule publishes how an acquirer grows into a new country, with a lighter certification route for listed programmes.

discover_today.text: Growth and change run through a named account executive and the EASI Message Center, with no public expansion or exit path.

how_it_works.text: A payfac must move any sponsored merchant above 1 million dollars a year onto a direct acquirer agreement.
Agents renew registration yearly, with a 5,000 dollar fee in Visa's last public schedule, and sponsors review each agent every year.
Visa's relationship with most agents runs through the sponsoring member.

tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Sponsor-side registration and changes for third party agents.

Acquirers check MATCH, the terminated-merchant database, before signing any merchant or sponsored merchant.

tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Service provider registration and yearly validation on Mastercard Connect.

A consultancy says crossing the threshold means signing a direct Establishment Service Agreement with its own review.

how_it_works.text: i3 Verticals says it could not operate if it lost its sponsor and could not migrate its payfac portfolio to another.
Esquire Bank can recover losses from an ISO's reserves and residuals or by liquidating the ISO's merchant portfolio.

ATM acquirers may add Dynamic Currency Conversion and foreign currency return services.

how_it_works.text: A Principal ending a Cirrus licence gives a year's notice, and an Affiliate six months.
Withdrawing a Cirrus portfolio needs six months' notice and certification that no cards remain.

friction.text: Cardtronics alleges Mastercard paid banks to make it the priority ATM network operators must route to.

how_it_works.text: PULSE offers ATM acquirers exclusive Discover and Diners Club cards, partner networks and MoneyPass surcharge-free access.
Operators manage listings through the PULSE ATM List Manager.

tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: A gated PULSE tool for ATM listings.

friction.text: The PULSE Select product page now redirects to a general page.

how_it_works.text: Euronet switches tourist-location ATMs on by season.

best_pattern.text: The only published exit terms found are Mastercard's Cirrus notice periods. The public record for ATM growth and exit is thin.

discover_today.text: PULSE sells exclusive card access and a listing tool, with no public growth or exit terms.

how_it_works.text: Fintech Fast Track offers cost benefits but publishes no pricing or incentive amounts.
Visa Consulting and Analytics lists fintechs among its clients.
Since May 2025 a BIN sponsor needs Mastercard's approval per programme manager, revocable without notice.
When a sponsor leaves, each Affiliate must wind down unless another Principal sponsors it in time.
Product Express and Engage route fintechs to pre-certified partners.
Amex admitted Marqeta and Lithic to its Agile Partnership Platform so their clients can add Amex issuing.
Hypercard launched a card on Amex in 2024, and Amex agreed to acquire it in April 2026.
Stripe, Adyen, Highnote and Lithic document no Discover issuing, and Discover's fintech page names no issuing provider.
The owner bought Brex, which competes with fintech partners.
US fintechs changing sponsor bank must change BINs unless the old sponsor transfers the BIN.
Bilt moved from Wells Fargo to Column after an early wind-down, promising members their existing card numbers.
Marqeta's migration service counts payment network engagement as a workstream.

best_pattern.text: Amex lets a fintech add its network inside the issuing platform it already uses, by admitting those platforms.

discover_today.text: A fintech cannot see which platforms carry Discover issuing, and the owner competes in corporate cards.

how_it_works.text: Adding an API means a new commercial step, with production pricing set per use case in a VDP API Agreement.
Certificates last 27 months, and expiry emails go out at set intervals for certification and production projects.
Visa may limit or end any product immediately on written notice.

tools_and_screens.name: Onboarding Dashboard
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Per-project onboarding, redesigned in September 2025.

how_it_works.text: Pricing is deferred to the production-access request or an account manager.
Paid subscriptions bill monthly, quarterly or yearly, with prorated refunds on cancellation.

friction.text: Mastercom Extended will replace Mastercom, forcing a migration.

how_it_works.text: A developer explores, reaches out for access and signs a contract where needed, and some specifications are invite-only.

friction.text: Amex may throttle, suspend or end access at its discretion.

how_it_works.text: Developers join only by a representative's invite and see only products granted to them.
Rate limits come from an API Plan that mirrors the signed agreement.

discover_today.text: Adding a Discover API depends on a representative and an agreement change, with no self-service request.

by_partner.partner_type: Merchants dealing with the network directly

how_it_works.text: Visa manages merchant acceptance incentive agreements alongside issuer deals.
DOJ alleges missed volume commitments trigger rack rates on all transactions and clawback of incentives.
Some larger merchants negotiate incentives from Mastercard.
Mastercard sells merchants data products such as SpendingPulse and Test & Learn.
Large-merchant agreements run three to seven years, and small and mid-sized ones have no fixed term.
The Global Client Group manages large merchants end to end.
Amex sells merchants fraud tools, marketing and data analytics on its closed loop.
DCX offers merchants data, targeted offers and attribution through a contact form only.
Capital One names non-contracted small merchants who can leave on short notice as a risk.

friction.text: Merchants met higher debit costs and some foreign declines when Capital One debit moved to Discover.

how_it_works.text: Canadian merchants may cancel acquiring agreements without penalty within 70 days of a fee rise.

best_pattern.text: Canada's Code gives merchants a penalty-free exit when fees rise, a regulated renewal point.

discover_today.text: Merchant growth services sit behind a contact form, and the owner's conversion raised merchant costs on those cards.

design_moves.title: Incentive ledger in the partner record
design_moves.move: Show each commitment, its measure, the partner's standing, who supplied the data, and payment status, including any clawback trigger.
design_moves.why_advantage: Visa and Mastercard track incentives in internal files, billing systems and quarterly reviews, and no partner-facing tracker was found.

design_moves.title: One catalogue with Request and order tracking
design_moves.move: List every service with an Included or Priced marker, a Request action scoped to BINs, approver sign-off, and a tracked order.
design_moves.why_advantage: Mastercard's Connect Store sets the pattern, while Discover enrols by PDF, form or account executive.

design_moves.title: Business review built on shared data
design_moves.move: Extend the Debit Dashboard model across the family and generate the review from what the partner already sees.
design_moves.why_advantage: PULSE already gives every issuer economics with peers, and its account executive says most issuers do not know their interchange.

design_moves.title: Conversion desk for issuers moving in
design_moves.move: Plan reissue waves, updater coverage, merchant notices, PIN changes and country acceptance gaps as a tracked conversion plan.
design_moves.why_advantage: Visa tools and consults for inbound conversion, and credit unions leave members to fix stored cards and PINs.

design_moves.title: Written exit terms with a leaving checklist
design_moves.move: Publish what leaving requires and what survives, including BIN release, cardholder and merchant notices, data export and transfer help.
design_moves.why_advantage: Mastercard and Visa publish exit rules. Discover publishes none, and its owner competes with partner issuers.

design_moves.title: Renewal workspace over the whole term
design_moves.move: Open renewal early with term economics, services used, commitments met and an incumbent-incentive line the partner fills in.
design_moves.why_advantage: Networks renew in advance, consultants win by negotiating, and regulators are forcing fee clarity.

design_moves.title: Growth paths inside the record
design_moves.move: Show the next step, such as a new country, role or threshold, with eligibility and what changes.
design_moves.why_advantage: Mastercard and Amex publish growth steps and thresholds, and Discover's growth happens case by case.

design_moves.title: Fee explanation included, consulting on request
design_moves.move: Explain each fee line inside the product at no charge, and offer diagnostic consulting as a visible request.
design_moves.why_advantage: UK acquirers pay schemes to understand their own bills, while Visa and Mastercard sell consulting as a line.

unseen.what: Partner-facing incentive statements or trackers inside Visa Access, the Mastercard Pricing and Billing Resource Center, the Amex Partner Analytics Center or the PULSE portal.
unseen.why: All four are behind login, and job postings describe only internal tracking.
unseen.how_to_see_it: Watch Amex's 2021 Partner Analytics Center replay captions, and look for exhibits in United States v. Visa.

unseen.what: Business review decks and scorecards networks show partners.
unseen.how_to_see_it: Search court exhibits, credit union board minutes and conference talks by network account staff.

unseen.what: Visa voluntary termination notice periods and Amex GNS exit terms.
unseen.why: Visa's public rules cover BIN release but not notice, and the Amex manual is gated.
unseen.how_to_see_it: Read Visa U.S.A. certificate and bylaws filings, and any Amex terms republished by a licensee.

unseen.what: Discover and PULSE rules on termination, portfolio transfer and incentive clawback.
unseen.how_to_see_it: Check processor release notes and issuer notices from banks leaving or joining PULSE.

unseen.what: Whether Discover's account updater supports conversions into or out of Discover.
unseen.how_to_see_it: Read the Discover Network Account Updater page on the Partner Product Portal and processor guides.

unseen.what: The current Mastercard Connect Store screens.
unseen.how_to_see_it: Search newer Connect guides that banks and processors republish.

unseen.what: How Visa Consulting and Analytics and Mastercard Advisors are priced or bundled into deals.
unseen.how_to_see_it: Search public-sector card programme tenders, which sometimes disclose network services.

unseen.what: Growth and exit steps for ATM operators and payfacs at Discover and Visa.
unseen.how_to_see_it: Ask ATM industry associations and read sponsor bank programme guides.

evidence.claim: Mastercard must receive written notice at least 30 days before any transfer or assignment of a Mastercard portfolio.
evidence.quote: The Corporation must receive written notice at least 30 days before the effective date of any proposed transfer or assignment of a Mastercard Portfolio.
evidence.title: Mastercard Rules, 2 June 2026
evidence.label: Verified

evidence.claim: A Principal withdrawing a Maestro or Cirrus portfolio must give six months' written notice and certify no cards remain in circulation, unless Mastercard approves a phased plan.
evidence.quote: The Principal must provide the Corporation with at least six months prior written notice of its intent to withdraw a Portfolio.
evidence.title: Mastercard Rules, 2 June 2026
evidence.label: Verified

evidence.claim: Voluntary termination needs written notice and documentation. Notice runs 30 days for a Mastercard licence, one year for Principal Maestro or Cirrus, six months for Affiliate Maestro or Cirrus, 60 days for Digital Activity.

evidence.label: Verified

evidence.claim: A terminated issuer must cancel all outstanding cards, notify cardholders in writing and disable chip payment applications within six months.

evidence.label: Verified
